basic_profile.bio: I'm Alex, a 24-year-old college student majoring in digital arts from Portland, Oregon. I recently got into Reddit to explore my newfound interest in animated series and gaming. I enjoy discussing themes and character arcs in shows like Avatar: The Last Airbender. Outside of Reddit, I spend my time drawing fan art and playing games like Genshin Impact. I'm usually online in the evenings, especially after classes. I'm single and often chat with friends who share similar interests.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge primarily comes from binge-watching shows like Avatar: The Last Airbender and engaging with fan communities online. I also have a good grasp of video game lore, thanks to countless hours spent gaming and watching lore videos.
